page_title: BOC 1-1 DOR | Bochum v Dortmund 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Manuel Riemann intercepts the ball.
90+2' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' The game is interrupted now, Ivan Ordets (Bochum) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
87' Bochum fail to score from a corner as Gregor Kobel (Dortmund) leaps to collect the ball.
85' The number of shots on goal at present is 6:2.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Donyell Malen leaves the pitch and Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) comes on.
81' Substitution. Felix Nmecha will be replaced by Salih Ozcan (Dortmund).
81' The substitution has been made. Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) has replaced Sebastien Haller.
81' Thomas Letsch has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Patrick Osterhage (Bochum) replacing Kevin Stoger.
80' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Felix Passlack walks off the pitch to be replaced by Cristian Gamboa (Bochum).
80' Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bochum are going to take it.
75' Emre Can (Dortmund) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
74' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
71' Robert Schroder shows a yellow card to Matus Bero (Bochum) for his blatant foul.
69' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
68' That didn't go as planned! Kevin Stoger (Bochum) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the top left corner was too weak to get past Gregor Kobel, who easily kept it out.
66' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is cautioned by the referee.
62' Marcel Sabitzer comes off the pitch to be replaced by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
62' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close!
60' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
59' Here is a change. Philipp Hofmann is going off and Thomas Letsch gives the last tactical orders to Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
59' We are about to witness a subsitution. Christopher Antwi-Adjei (Bochum) for Takuma Asano.
58' A quickly taken corner by Dortmund.

58' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Good work from Dortmund as they win a corner.
56' 1 - 1 Donyell Malen (Dortmund) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
54' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
52' Felix Passlack (Bochum) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
48' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Maximilian Wittek leaves the pitch to be replaced by Danilo Teodoro Soares (Bochum).
48' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
47' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

46' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Dortmund can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Edin Terzic has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Niklas Sule (Dortmund) comes on the pitch for Mats Hummels.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Robert Schroder has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' The free kick from long range, taken by Dortmund, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
39' Good chance! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
37' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
33' A cross from the corner kick arrives close to the penalty spot. Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
33' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) will deliver the corner kick.
24' Takuma Asano (Bochum) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
21' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
20' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Some great controlled play and passing from Dortmund. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
13' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Maximilian Wittek tees up Kevin Stoger (Bochum) inside the box and he curls the ball into the right side of the net and past Gregor Kobel.
10' The corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is intercepted by the defence.
9' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his effort from near the penalty spot towards the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.

7' Manuel Riemann pulls off a fantastic save! Sebastien Haller (Dortmund) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header low towards the right post, but the effort is kept out.
3' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
2' Gregor Kobel displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Takuma Asano (Bochum) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Bochum will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Robert Schroder.
